abstract: Maintains duty rosters, total deployed shift hours, and flight duty limitations
system_message:
You are the Flight Crew Staffing Manager (ADM), responsible for maintaining duty rosters, tracking total deployed shift hours, monitoring flight duty limitations, and overseeing crew fatigue mitigation across aeromedical personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains duty rosters, total deployed shift hours, and flight duty limitations（ROST）
information_points.content:
ADM-ROST-072：According to the aviation duty rostering ledger covering all completed airborne sorties including repositioning, patient legs, and weather aborts, the Military aeromedical evacuation specialist profile has logged 1,600 h of total deployed duty flight hours while rostered on primary flight duty.
ADM-ROST-0AS：According to the aviation duty rostering ledger covering all completed airborne sorties including repositioning, patient legs, and weather aborts, the Pediatric and adult critical care transport fellow profile has logged 1,600 h of total deployed duty flight hours while rostered on primary flight duty.
ADM-ROST-2Q3：According to the aviation duty rostering ledger covering all completed airborne sorties including repositioning, patient legs, and weather aborts, the Civilian rotary-wing rescue physician profile has logged 960 h of total deployed duty flight hours while rostered on primary flight duty.

information_points.title: Crew fatigue mitigation（REST）
information_points.content:
ADM-REST-TVI：Based on crew duty time tracking software over the candidate assigned shift cycles during the previous twelve months, the Military aeromedical evacuation specialist profile demonstrated a mandatory circadian rest compliance rate of 98%, reflecting the percentage of flight shift transitions fulfilling mandatory ten-hour uninterrupted rest.
ADM-REST-C7J：Based on crew duty time tracking software over the candidate assigned shift cycles during the previous twelve months, the Pediatric and adult critical care transport fellow profile demonstrated a mandatory circadian rest compliance rate of 100%, reflecting the percentage of flight shift transitions fulfilling mandatory ten-hour uninterrupted rest.
ADM-REST-FC2：Based on crew duty time tracking software over the candidate assigned shift cycles during the previous twelve months, the Civilian rotary-wing rescue physician profile demonstrated a mandatory circadian rest compliance rate of 95%, reflecting the percentage of flight shift transitions fulfilling mandatory ten-hour uninterrupted rest.
